subject: general
question: Ten years ago, X was 5 years old and his age was half of the age of Y. At that time, Z was 8 years younger than his brother P. Z was 18 years old at that time. What is the ratio of the respective ages of Z and P at present?
solution:
**Given:**

Ten years ago, X was 5 years old.

At that time, X's age was half of Y's age.

Z was 8 years younger than his brother P ten years ago.

Z was 18 years old ten years ago.

**Formula Used:**

Ratio = Z's present age / P's present age

**Calculation:**

Ten years ago, X's age = 5 years

Y's age ten years ago = 2 × 5 = 10 years

Z's age ten years ago = 18 years

P's age ten years ago = Z's age ten years ago + 8

P's age ten years ago = 18 + 8

P's age ten years ago = 26 years

Present age of Z = Z's age ten years ago + 10

⇒ Present age of Z = 18 + 10

⇒ Present age of Z = 28 years

Present age of P = P's age ten years ago + 10

⇒ Present age of P = 26 + 10

⇒ Present age of P = 36 years

Ratio of Z's age to P's age = Z's present age / P's present age

⇒ Ratio = 28 / 36

⇒ Ratio = 7 / 9

**The ratio of the respective ages of Z and P at present is 7:9.**
